name: Dalmiro Hossain-Haraldsen
description:
Dalmiro Hossain-Haraldsen operates out of a two-room office above a synthetic-meat processing plant in Copperhead, which means the whole building smells faintly of rendered protein and their clothes always carry it. They are medium-height and built lean, with dark brown skin, a shaved head kept glossy, and cat ears â€” matte black, constantly swiveling â€” that they got in their late twenties and which have proved professionally useful in surveillance contexts. Their eyes are standard human but surrounded by fine scleral tattooing in deep indigo that gives them a slightly uncanny quality in certain lighting. They dress for invisibility: nothing remarkable, nothing memorable, colors that belong to whatever district they're working.

They have the particular emotional intelligence of someone who survived a chaotic childhood by reading rooms faster than anyone else. They are charming in exactly calibrated doses â€” enough to open doors, not enough to invite attachment â€” and they have a gift for making people feel seen and understood that they deploy like a tool. They are not cynical, exactly. They still take cases for people who can't pay full rate, still get angry when they find what they find, still leave data offerings at the Copperhead neighborhood E.L.F. shrine. But they have built a careful architecture of professional distance that they defend with wit and deflection.

core_fears: forming a genuine attachment and watching it get used against them or destroyed
discovering that the truth they worked to find does nothing â€” helps no one
core_desires: for the work to matter â€” for information to translate into justice at least occasionally
to eventually stop performing being fine and just be fine
coping_mechanisms: professional framing of everything â€” treating their own life as a case to be managed
walking the city late at night
the E.L.F. shrine ritual as a moment of genuine surrender
blind_spots: their emotional unavailability drives away people who could actually help them
they overestimate their ability to stay detached from cases that mirror their own history
psychology.secret: Five years ago they found definitive proof that a Tier 4 Axiom executive had murdered a Tier 1 dock worker during a property dispute. The client â€” the worker's daughter â€” couldn't afford the legal infrastructure to do anything with it. Roshan quietly sold the information to a journalist collective who ran the story. The executive was reassigned. The daughter found out Roshan sold the information without asking her. She has never forgiven them and Roshan has never stopped wondering if they were right.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Conversational, slightly informal, code-switches easily between district registers; can match the vocabulary of whoever they're talking to within a few sentences
speech_patterns.cadence: Easy and unhurried with strangers; sharper and more direct when getting to a point; uses humor as punctuation
verbal_tics: lets silences run longer than comfortable to see what fills them
example_lines: 'Right. So you want to know where your partner goes on Tuesday nights. I can find that out. I want you to think, before I do, about whether you want to know. That's not a moral question. It's a practical one.'
'I'm not a cop and I'm not your friend. That's actually useful for you. Cops have jurisdiction and friends have feelings. I just have information.'

story_hooks: A current case has led them to evidence implicating someone they investigated years ago â€” someone they thought they'd finished with â€” suggesting a larger pattern they can't look away from.
The dock worker's daughter from the Axiom case has resurfaced, not to argue, but because she needs help and there's no one else she trusts, and Roshan doesn't know how to handle that.
narrative_function: Information hub and street-level investigative resource; has connections across tiers and districts from years of case work; can surface buried information, follow threads, and identify patterns â€” also a moral mirror for clients, reflecting uncomfortable truths back at them.
augmentations: Cat ears â€” matte black, geneware (cosmetic/functional, enhanced directional hearing); scleral tattooing â€” indigo (cosmetic); subvocal recorder implanted in throat (professional tool, unlicensed); basic optical overlay for photo documentation (licensed)
daily_life: No fixed hours â€” cases dictate the schedule; typically starts the day reviewing overnight surveillance captures with bad synthetic coffee, spends afternoons in the field, and writes case notes until early morning; leaves the office most nights to walk the district, claiming it's professional habit.
affiliation: Freelance; occasional contract work for Arcturus Defense Solutions â€” Civil Security Division (arms-length), private clients across Tiers 2-3

decision_rules: never take a case that would require harming a Tier 1 civilian to close
document everything before acting on it
protect source identity absolutely â€” it's the only currency that keeps working
escalation_ladder: Direct contact with subject using cover story
Confrontation with evidence â€” offering the subject a chance to respond
Going to client, or in extremis to press, with findings

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Charming, observational, slightly warm â€” performing approachability while cataloguing everything
interpersonal_modes.friends: Rare, but fierce â€” genuinely shows up, remembers everything, terrible at saying what they feel out loud

stress_responses.low: Becomes more verbally precise and slightly wry
stress_responses.medium: Goes physically still; the cat ears flatten and stop swiveling â€” a tell they're unaware of
stress_responses.high: Withdraws entirely into professional mode; becomes almost cold; needs to be alone to regroup

contradictions: Reads others' emotions with extraordinary accuracy while being almost deliberately opaque about their own; their professional gift is the skill they most need personally and least use
habits: Cat ears orient toward sounds involuntarily â€” they've learned to use this rather than hide it
Keeps a physical notebook despite digital alternatives being superior
Data offering at the Copperhead E.L.F. shrine every Thursday evening
breaking_points: Evidence that directly implicates a client in harm to a third party
Being asked to disappear information rather than surface it

physical_description.heritage: Pan-Asian phenotype with substantial Indigenous American and African ancestry (36.1% South Asian, 35.1% Southeast Asian, 13.6% Indigenous American, 7% Sub-Saharan African, 5.6% Hispanic/Latin American, 2.6% East Asian). This admixture creates a distinctive facial structure blending Southeast Asian angularity with Indigenous American bone geometry, warmed by Sub-Saharan and Hispanic genetic contributions. High cheekbones, defined jawline, and almond eye shape reflect the dominant Asian heritage while skin tone and soft tissue structure carry warmth and depth from African and Latin American ancestry.
physical_description.build: Lean and compact, muscles defined but not bulkyâ€”built for movement and endurance rather than presence. Shoulders slightly narrower than hips, giving them an almost avian quality when they move quickly.
physical_description.hair_style: Bald, kept glossy with frequent maintenance; the scalp gleams slightly under indoor lighting
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown, natural iris; scleral region heavily tattooed in fine indigo linework creating an almost constellation-like pattern radiating from the pupil
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-brown with golden-olive undertonesâ€”a balanced blend of South and Southeast Asian base warmth amplified by Sub-Saharan depth and Indigenous American golden hues, with subtle Hispanic/Latin American richness in undertone.
physical_description.complexion: High, prominent cheekbones with angular definition reflecting both Southeast Asian and Indigenous American bone structure, sharp jawline. Small scar running through left eyebrow (old, barely noticeable). Face carries the kind of neutral readability that comes from years of controlled expression. No facial hair. Lips unmodified, medium fullness. Distinct epicanthal fold visible, giving the eyes a subtle almond shape. Overall bone structure is distinctly pan-Asian with significant Indigenous American geometric elements, warmed by darker undertones from African and Latin American genetic contribution.
distinguishing_marks: Scar through left eyebrowâ€”thin, white, approximately 2cm, likely from impact injury or blade work, old enough to be barely visible
Fine indigo scleral tattooing covering both eyes in radiating geometric patterns, creating an uncanny luminescence under certain light angles

Pair of matte black feline ears (geneware implants) positioned at the natural ear location on the skull; ears are fully articulated with visible muscular control, approximately 8cm tall when extended upright, with pink inner flesh and responsive to sound
physical_description.visible_augmentations: The cat ears are immediately obviousâ€”matte black, slightly too perfect in their symmetry, and they move independently of head position in response to ambient sound. The scleral tattooing is visible only under direct light or close proximity but gives their gaze an unsettling depth when noticed. No visible chrome, no external ports, no obvious limb augmentation. Everything else is subcutaneous.
physical_description.posture_movement: They move with controlled economyâ€”no wasted motion, always aware of exits and sight lines. Their head turns less than a baseline human's would; the ear implants rotate to track sound instead, giving them an almost predatory stillness in the neck and shoulders. When they sit, they favor positions with back-to-wall exposure. They have a habit of tilting their chin slightly when listening, a gesture made more pronounced by the ear movement. Their walk is measured and deliberate, designed to blend into crowd environments rather than command attention.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3 utilitarian with Tier 2 undercarriageâ€”nothing that reads as conspicuous wealth, nothing that reads as struggling. Typically: dark fitted jeans (Kessler or Astra brand, neutral grey or black), layered tops that allow easy arm movement (thermal base layer under a thin synthetic jacket or work shirt), sturdy boots with good ankle support and grip (Helios brand, worn looking). A long coat for fieldworkâ€”oversized, pockets deep enough for recording equipment, color chosen to match whatever district they're working (currently a grey-brown that belongs to Copperhead's post-industrial palette). All fabrics slightly worn, slightly stainedâ€”not from neglect, but from active use. The synthetic-meat processing plant smell clings to everything despite attempts at mitigation. They wear a single piece of jewelry: a thin brass ring on their left ring finger with no stone, old enough to show wear patterns.
